basic_details.job_title: SSCBS Non Teaching Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for Assistant, Junior Assistant and More Posts
basic_details.short_information: Shaheed Sukhdev College of Business Studies (University of Delhi) (SSCBS) has notified 6 vacancies for Assistant, Library Assistant, and Junior Assistant posts on a deputation basis, with offline applications to be submitted through proper channel to The Principal, Shaheed Sukhdev College of Business Studies (University of Delhi), PSP Area IV, Dr. K.N. Katju Marg on or before 2 November 2026, and hard copies reaching the college by 9 November 2026. qualification.details: Assistant Eligibility: A Bachelor’s degree from a recognized Institute/University; two-year experience as Junior Assistant or equivalent in a University, Research Establishment, Central/State Govt., PSU, Autonomous Bodies, or equivalent pay package in reputed Private Companies/corporate banks with a minimum annual turnover of at least Rs. 200 Crores or more; English typing @ 35 wpm or Hindi typing @ 30 wpm; proficiency in computer operations; one week of job specific training/skill enhancement program conducted by a College/University. | Library Assistant Eligibility: Bachelor’s degree in Library & Information Science or equivalent from a recognized University. | Junior Assistant Eligibility: A Bachelor’s degree from a recognized Institute/University; English typing @ 35 wpm or Hindi typing @ 30 wpm; proficiency in computer operations.

selection_process: The selection will be made on the basis of quality of ACRs and interview. Persons on direct line of promotion in the cadre are not eligible for appointment on deputation basis. The deputation period is initially for one year extendable annually up to three years.

rows.details: Shaheed Sukhdev College of Business Studies (University of Delhi)
Bachelor's degree with post-specific experience and typing speed

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Applicants must send the hard copy of the duly filled application form along with self-attested copies of all testimonials, attested photocopies of APARs for the last three years, and Vigilance Clearance and Integrity Certificate issued by the parent institute to: The Principal, Shaheed Sukhdev College of Business Studies (University of Delhi), PSP Area IV, Dr. K.N. Katju Marg, Sector 16, Rohini, Delhi – 110 089. The envelope must be super-scribed as “Application for the post of [Post Name]”. Applications must be routed through proper channel.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: Assistant Eligibility: A Bachelor’s degree from a recognized Institute/University; two-year experience as Junior Assistant or equivalent in a University, Research Establishment, Central/State Govt., PSU, Autonomous Bodies, or equivalent pay package in reputed Private Companies/corporate banks with a minimum annual turnover of at least Rs. 200 Crores or more; English typing @ 35 wpm or Hindi typing @ 30 wpm; proficiency in computer operations; one week of job specific training/skill enhancement program conducted by a College/University. Library Assistant Eligibility: Bachelor’s degree in Library & Information Science or equivalent from a recognized University. Junior Assistant Eligibility: A Bachelor’s degree from a recognized Institute/University; English typing @ 35 wpm or Hindi typing @ 30 wpm; proficiency in computer operations.

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Duly filled up application form with self-attested copies of all testimonials. Attested photocopies of APARs for the last three years. Vigilance Clearance and Integrity Certificate issued by the parent institute. Proof of date of birth certificate (Class X Certificate). Caste certificate, if applicable. Physically handicapped certificate, if applicable.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: The selection will be made on the basis of quality of ACRs and interview. Persons on direct line of promotion in the cadre are not eligible for appointment on deputation basis. The deputation period is initially for one year extendable annually up to three years.

rows.event: Last Date for Hard Copy Receipt

rows.details: Download official notification and application form

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to submit the application for SSCBS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date for filling up the application form is 2 November 2026, and the hard copy must reach the college within 7 days, by 9 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. Who is eligible for appointment on deputation under these rules?
faq.answer: Persons who are on direct line of promotion in the cadre are not eligible for appointment on deputation basis, and persons selected on deputation will not be eligible for absorption.

faq.question: Q3. What documents are required to be attached with the application form?
faq.answer: Applicants must attach self-attested copies of all testimonials, APARs for the last three years, Vigilance Clearance and Integrity Certificate from the parent institute, Class X certificate for date of birth, and caste or physically handicapped certificates if applicable.

faq.question: Q4. Is there any application fee mentioned in the notification?
faq.answer: The official notification does not mention any application fee.
